turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR) for 1-30 September 2026, cancelled orders excluded, was 12,582.75 EUR, but the semantic layer can only count orders on their UTC order date, not on Amsterdam calendar days, so orders near midnight may fall on a different day than in your books. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
